words.meaning: A common illness that makes you sneeze and cough.
words.example: I have a cold and feel tired.
words.example_fa: سرماخوردگی دارم و احساس خستگی می‌کنم.

words.meaning: To make your hair neat with a comb.
words.example: Please comb your hair before school.
words.example_fa: لطفاً قبل از مدرسه موهایت را شانه کن.

words.meaning: To produce tears from your eyes, usually from sadness.
words.example: The baby started to cry loudly.
words.example_fa: نوزاد شروع کرد به بلند گریه کردن.

words.meaning: To make an opening in skin with something sharp.
words.example: Be careful not to cut your finger.

words.meaning: A doctor who takes care of teeth.
words.example: I have an appointment with the dentist.
